name: What is involved in painting and finishing for a new home addition?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in painting and finishing for a new home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting and finishing for a new home addition typically involves several steps. First, surfaces are prepared by cleaning, sanding, and priming. Then, two coats of paint are usually applied to walls and ceilings. Trim work, such as baseboards and crown molding, also receives preparation and paint. Finally, any new cabinetry or built-ins will be stained or painted, and often a protective topcoat is applied. The process ensures a cohesive look with the existing structure and protects the new surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: It involves surface preparation, priming, painting walls, ceilings, and trim, and finishing new cabinetry or built-ins.
